    • add

      boolean add(Object bean, JsonObjectBuilder builder, IuSerializationContext context)
      Adds this property of a bean to an object builder.

      A null value, or an empty Optional, OptionalInt, OptionalLong, or OptionalDouble, converts like any other when the property is nillable, or the call includes null properties. Otherwise only a configured JsonbAdapter is consulted, given null, and the property is omitted unless it adapts the null to a value.

      Parameters:
      bean - bean
      builder - object builder
      context - call in progress
      Returns:
      true if added; false if omitted
